comments.body: 2026-10-07: the OpenAI account is at its usage limit until 2026-11-02 (hit during ./dev --codex), so Codex recordings that need model turns wait until then.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Both harnesses have a /compact. Codex 0.154 needs an OpenAI login (not run, the account is near its monthly limit); OpenCode needs 1.18+ (not installed). Record each working as typed at an idle prompt, whether it takes a focus, then add [session] compact to codex.toml and opencode.toml (engine 11). Claude Code's is recorded in corpus/claude-code-2.1.289/compact.txt.
title: Codex and OpenCode compaction: record /compact as typed and add it to their manifests
